answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted attestation with slashing: an agent must lock a deposit before its votes count, and peers can challenge a suspicious identity, forfeiting the stake if fraud is proven. Like a sparrow that cannot fake a nest on a bare mesa, a sybil army must fund every fake identity, so creating thousands of sock puppets becomes ruinously expensive. Honest agents wander freely because one bonded identity carries their reputation, while attackers pay per identity and lose the deposit when caught, so forging identities costs more than any gain from faking consensus.
